ada: Quick check — uploaded a terse cost/quality snapshot for new-model-v2. Link: https://redwood/internal/bench/5109
ada: TL;DR: 13B fp16 vs 13B int8 (QAT-like) — median latency +12ms, p95 +45ms, tokens/sec drop ~8%, cost per 1M tokens: $45 fp16 vs $18 int8. Quality delta: chrF/ROUGE +0.6 relative for fp16 on longform. Thoughts for GTN (chat assistant) rollout?
benchbot: perf-summary: run=5109, model=new-model-v2, fp16: p50=98ms p95=210ms cost_1M=45; int8: p50=110ms p95=255ms cost_1M=18; eval_set=gt-1000
kai: Thanks. Those p95 deltas worry me — may push tail latency beyond SLO for sync routes.
frank: Agreed. But cost delta is huge. Could we hybrid-route small percent of traffic to fp16 for long-form prompts? e.g., rule: if token_count > 256 -> fp16 else int8
liz: @ada can we get a small slice of real user traffic (1%) + baseline A/B for 2 days? Also need quality samples on top-10 intents.
ada: Yes, I can spin a canary. Proposed plan: 1% traffic int8 baseline + 0.5% fp16 for longform; collect token econ + user-grade metrics; failover to fp16 on >p99 latency.
frank: Also add a KV cache warmstart to int8 path — might reduce p50 gap.
kai: If we can't meet p95 SLO, I'd prefer keeping fp16 for sync chat and put int8 on async/generation jobs.
liz: For GTN ask: product tolerates occasional minor regressions in style but not factuality. We should run hallucination/regression tests (prompt corpus attached).
ada: Attached quick eval command: ```python run_eval.py --model new-model-v2-int8 --slices gt_nat_lang,gt_longform --metrics rouge,exact_match,hallucination_rate``` 
benchbot: eval-summary: halluc_rate_int8=1.8% vs fp16=1.4% (delta 0.4pp). rouge_drop_int8=0.5
frank: Given numbers, my recommendation: Canary int8 for stateless short-turn routes; keep fp16 for longform/dialogue until cache/latency improvements. Target 30% cost reduction across mixed traffic.
ada: Agreed. I'll draft a short runbook for canary + rollback conditions and post results in 48hrs. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
kai: Ping me when canary goes live, I'll watch latency dashboards.
liz: Adding GTN PM to the thread — @morgan FYI
morgan: Thanks — sounds like a sane plan. Please include a short blurb for GTN decision doc.
